title: Pairing with a Single-Entry Matrix
statement: Let $N$ be a natural number, let $i,j$ be indices in $\{0,\ldots,N-1\}$, and let $z$ be a vector of length $N$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Pairing the matrix with entry $1$ at $(i,j)$ and $0$ elsewhere with the matrix whose $(a,b)$ entry is $z_a z_b$ gives $z_i z_j$.
hypotheses_covered: $z$ is a vector of length $N$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$
